# TOHEŞAR OBJECT LAB — 01 SHADOW real one-piece sample sourcing
**Research: 2026-11-09 KST. Evidence of advertised components ONLY; NOT a tested selected-SKU checkout, real stock, or purchasing authorization.**

## Decision
Prioritize **WEFORM × BECANVAS 32s double-ply pigment shirt** as the conditional 1-piece printed sample candidate. It explicitly lists small left-chest DTF printing price and accepts PNG uploads. If checkout or inventory blocks selection, **pivot to BODATEE** rather than repeating the same failed vendor request.

### Route A — WEFORM, new one-print price components
- Exact product: https://oasisent1.cafe24.com/product/%EB%B9%84%EC%BA%94%EB%B2%84%EC%8A%A4-%ED%94%BC%EA%B7%B8%EB%A8%BC%ED%8A%B8-%EB%B0%98%ED%8C%94-%ED%8B%B0%EC%85%94%EC%B8%A0-32%EC%88%98-2%ED%95%A9/10462/category/95/display/1/
- BECANVAS 피그먼트 반팔 티셔츠 32수 2합: public base **₩15,000**. Explicit **빠른 인쇄 (DTF)**, **왼가슴 (로고 사이즈) +₩2,000**, ordinary shipping **₩3,000** below ₩100,000. Listed upload formats: JPG, PNG, AI, PSD, max **10 MB**, after product option selection.
- **15,000 + 2,000 + 3,000 = ₩20,000**, mathematical **advertised-component target, NOT actual all-in/payable order quote**. Color/size surcharge, actual stock, full checkout, tax display, 82mm print qualification, preview and upload not verified. No selection made. A search-indexed variant shows SOLD OUT in purchase controls; this could be a template or actual unavailability. **UNKNOWN**, not ignored.
- Manufacturer independently lists **BECANVAS 32s 2ply pigment charcoal** product: https://becanvas.co.kr/shop_view/?idx=254 . Brand's ₩15,000 VAT-included minimum recommended resale price is NOT seller checkout, and does not prove WEFORM has charcoal in stock.

### Route B — BODATEE, real charcoal option and garment measurements
- Exact SKU https://m.bodatee.com/goods/goods_view.php?goodsNo=1000000842 ; BECANVAS 32수 2합 피그먼트 오버핏. Public color swatches show **차콜** explicitly among six color choices. Published **1~5 pcs ₩16,900/pc**, **standard shipping ₩5,000**; seller FAQ says retail prices include VAT. **₩21,900 shirt + shipping only (no printing)**. Public product supports one-piece price tier, while specific stock/print configuration remains unverified.
- Product material stated by seller: pigment dyed, **100% cotton 275 gsm**, S–3XL. Allowed print types: screen printing, embroidery, transfer, flock. Exact small one-color ivory original mark printing price UNKNOWN.
- Seller's published flat measurements (cm; shoulder / half-chest / sleeve / body length):
  - S: 52 / 55 / 21 / 68.5
  - M: 54 / 58 / 21 / 71
  - L: 56 / 61 / 22 / 73.5
  - XL: 58 / 64 / 23 / 76
  - 2XL: 61 / 67 / 24 / 78.5
  - 3XL: 64 / 70 / 25 / 81
- Seller indicates **2–3cm tolerances**, possible heat-process shrinkage and batch-to-batch pigment color shifts. No wearer size is selected or approved. Product says **printed final order is members-only** and artwork proof happens after order intake; therefore no editor acceptance has been demonstrated. Manufacturer can adjust extremely fine lines on output; reject any unapproved path modification, including original Ş.
